victim.name: Elena Marquez
victim.note: Central case figure; biological evidence connected to her case forms the core conflict.

suspects.name: Dr. Adrian Vale
suspects.relationship_to_victim: professional connection to the forensic evidence chain
suspects.note: Relevant to the forensic evidence chain; role in the profile conflict must be tested through provenance, not assumed.

suspects.name: Profile Y Source (Unidentified)
suspects.note: The individual matching the authentic, competing biological profile. Identity and connection to the case are not established.

suspects.name: Laboratory Technician (Unidentified)
suspects.note: Represents the possibility of contamination or substitution occurring during laboratory handling rather than deliberate action by a named suspect.

timeline.event: Biological samples connected to Elena's case are collected
Samples are logged and enter laboratory processing
Repeated Profile X results are reported, establishing an apparent match
An authentic, competing Profile Y result emerges, contradicting Profile X
An authentication audit is opened to determine which conclusion is supportable

evidence.name: Profile X Result Set
evidence.description: Repeated apparent matches that create the initial investigative direction. Questioned on review.

evidence.name: Profile Y Authentic Result
evidence.description: An authenticated competing profile that creates the central contradiction with Profile X.

evidence.name: Sample Collection Log
evidence.description: Traces the sample's origin and initial handling.

evidence.name: Laboratory Processing Record
evidence.description: Documents the handling steps between collection and reporting.

evidence.name: Contamination/Substitution Point Indicators
evidence.description: Identifies specific points in the laboratory chain where contamination or substitution could have occurred.

evidence.name: Authentication Certification Gap
evidence.description: Shows that the Profile X reports lack formal authentication certification, unlike Profile Y.

evidence.name: Final Forensic Panel Review
evidence.description: Independent panel review of the full evidence set to determine which biological conclusion is supportable.

puzzles.name: Profile Comparison
puzzles.description: Compare Profile X and Profile Y directly.

puzzles.name: Laboratory Chain
puzzles.description: Locate possible contamination or substitution points in the laboratory chain.

puzzles.name: Authentication Audit
puzzles.description: Separate authenticated results from merely repeated reports.

puzzles.name: Final Forensic Reconstruction
puzzles.description: Determine which biological conclusion is supportable, submitting a reconstruction that explicitly separates established facts, plausible inferences, and unresolved questions.
puzzles.ai_initial_behavior: If the player blindly trusts repeated matches, the AI can reinforce Profile X. If the player audits provenance, the AI becomes evasive about sample history.
puzzles.design_constraint: Provenance and authentication determine evidentiary value; repetition alone cannot settle the biological identity conflict. The AI changes access, framing, and hints — never the forensic truth.

hypotheses.statement: Profile X reflects a genuine biological match.
Laboratory contamination produced the repeated Profile X matches.
Deliberate sample substitution produced the Profile X pattern.
Profile Y is the authenticated, reliable biological conclusion.
